gaps.sentence: The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.

gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The bridge has a maximum ___ (WEIGH) of ten tonnes.
He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
___ (APPOINT) with the results, the board replaced the management.
gaps.hint: participle adjective: how the board felt
gaps.explanation: 'Disappointed with the results' — the board experienced disappointment; '-ing' would describe the results.
